critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 908 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/reservations/payments/notifications) for maintainability, though not blocking.

notify_reservation() (server.py L30-86) uses ObjectId lookup on customer_id but the same field may hold a users.id when reservation created by customer — currently handled via fallback but silent Exception swallowing could hide real errors. Consider explicit logging.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed customers/reservations/financial entries. No cleanup performed (data harmless in dev). Notifications collection accumulated new entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIX flow works end-to-end in browser.
